```{r}
#| label: homepage-overview-data
#| include: false

# Rebuild from configured Matches so the homepage cannot use stale summaries
# when Quarto renders it before the detailed report.
source("R/03_outplant_interval_workflow.R")
source("R/05_interactive_coki_map.R")
home_latest <- outplant_cumulative_survival_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(plot) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(survey_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(plot)
home_sites <- coki_map_summary |>
  dplyr::select(plot, display_name) |>
  dplyr::left_join(home_latest, by = "plot") |>
  dplyr::arrange(plot)
home_partial <- outplant_partial_cumulative_survival_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(plot) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(survey_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
home_latest_survey <- coki_map_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(latest_survey_date)) |>
  dplyr::filter(format(latest_survey_date, "%Y-%m") == format(max(latest_survey_date), "%Y-%m")) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(latest_survey_date), display_name)
home_e_april <- outplant_object_lineage_survival |>
  dplyr::filter(plot == "Plot E", cohort == "April 2026 additions") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(survey_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
home_count <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
```

<h3>Results by site</h3>

```{r}
#| label: homepage-plot-cards
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat('<div class="plot-overview-grid">')
for (i in seq_len(nrow(home_sites))) {
  site <- home_sites[i, ]
  site_id <- tolower(gsub(" ", "-", site$display_name, fixed = TRUE))
  survey_summary <- if (is.na(site$survey_date)) {
    "<p>No complete-section survivorship result is available.</p>"
  } else {
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<p class="plot-overview-value">%.1f%%</p>',
        '<p>%s of %s original coral annotations had a documented living descendant. %s unresolved.</p>',
        '<p class="plot-overview-date">Surveyed %s</p>'
      ),
      site$percent_cumulative_survival,
      home_count(site$n_surviving_from_baseline),
      home_count(site$n_baseline),
      home_count(site$n_unresolved),
      format(as.Date(site$survey_date), "%d %B %Y")
    )
  }
  site_partial <- dplyr::filter(home_partial, plot == site$plot)
  if (nrow(site_partial) > 0L &&
      (is.na(site$survey_date) || site_partial$survey_date > site$survey_date)) {
    survey_summary <- paste0(survey_summary, sprintf(
      '<p class="plot-overview-date">Newer partial survey: %s (%s of %s sections).</p>',
      format(site_partial$survey_date, "%d %B %Y"),
      site_partial$n_observed_sections, site_partial$expected_plot_sections
    ))
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    '<article class="plot-overview-card"><h4>%s</h4>%s<a href="coral_survivorship_report.html#%s">View %s results</a></article>',
    site$display_name, survey_summary, site_id, site$display_name
  ))
}
cat('</div>')
```

<p class="overview-note">Each card uses that site’s latest survey with complete section coverage. Researchers follow original coral annotations through documented splits and fusions. “Unresolved” means the survey record leaves the coral’s fate uncertain.</p>
</section>

By the `r format(as.Date(home_e_april$survey_date), "%d %B %Y")` survey, <strong>`r home_count(home_e_april$n_surviving)` of `r home_count(home_e_april$n_baseline)`</strong> coral annotations from that group had a documented living descendant. The fate of `r home_count(home_e_april$n_unresolved)` remained unresolved.</p>

```{r}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(home_latest_survey))) {
  latest <- home_latest_survey[i, ]
  site_name <- latest$display_name
  site_id <- tolower(gsub(" ", "-", site_name, fixed = TRUE))
  survey_date <- latest$latest_survey_date
  cat(sprintf(
    '<li><time datetime="%s">%s</time><a href="coral_survivorship_report.html#%s">%s survey results</a><span>%s</span></li>',
    format(survey_date, "%Y-%m-%d"), format(survey_date, "%d %B %Y"), site_id, site_name, latest$coverage_status
  ))
}
cat('</ul>')
```
